info.name: Falling Into You
info.plot: Duan Yucheng, a passionate high jumper, struggles with his height but finds guidance from coach Luo Na. Determined to succeed, he joins her university team, facing injuries, failures, and doubt along the way. As he competes from school-level to national championships, he pushes through every challenge, finding joy in his progress. Through it all, the track remains his greatest passion and driving force.

translations.title: 炽道
translations.overview: 在福建小岛渔村长大的段宇成梦想成为一名跳高运动员，在助教罗娜的循序善诱之下，不仅训练成绩突飞猛进，两人也在朝夕相处过程中情愫悄悄滋生，最终段宇成突破了极限也同时收获了和罗娜的真挚爱情。
